description: This file contains utility functions for string formatting used throughout the application, including functions to convert strings to camelCase and Title Case, with handling for various delimiters and accented characters.

methods.name: toCamelCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to camelCase, normalizing delimiters such as spaces, underscores, and hyphens; handles multiple whitespace and trims edges.

methods.name: toTitleCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to Title Case for display, with special handling for apostrophes and accented characters; normalizes delimiters and whitespace.
